question: How do I get character-level timestamps from the text-to-speech API?
ground_truth: To get character-level timestamps, use the POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/with-timestamps endpoint. Instead of returning a binary audio file, this endpoint returns a JSON response containing: audio_base64 (the audio encoded as base64), and an alignment object with characters (array of strings), character_start_times_seconds (array of numbers), and character_end_times_seconds (array of numbers). There's also a normalized_alignment field for normalized text alignment. This is useful for lip-syncing, karaoke-style applications, or any use case requiring precise timing information.

correctness: Must mention audio_base64 in the response
Must mention alignment object with character timing arrays
